name: Grief
languages: Common plus the languages it knew in life

Traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
Traits.text: The grief can move through other creatures and objects as if they were Difficult Terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

Traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
Traits.text: While in sunlight, the grief has Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls.

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The grief makes two Shadow Limb attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Drink the Warmth.

Actions.name: Shadow Limb
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +9, reach 5 ft. 23 (4d8 + 5) Bludgeoning damage plus 16 (3d10) Necrotic damage.

Actions.name: Drink the Warmth
Actions.text: *Wisdom Saving Throw*: DC 17, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. *Failure:* The target has the Frightened condition until the end of its next turn.
Actions.clause: When the grief hits a creature with its Shadow Limb, it can drink the warmth from the wound: the target must make a Cons
Actions.expresses: draining the living of warmth and vigor to deepen their despair
Actions.expressedQuote: The target has the Frightened condition until the end of its next turn.

lore: A grief is what remains when someone dies of sorrow so complete that the spirit refuses the grave, drifting through walls to find the despairing and drink them dry.

generation.cite: composition after Wraith (CR 5) — Life Drain under the sunlight bane

immunities: Poison; Charmed, Exhaustion, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained
